defects.defect: Energy chip text overlaps itself: '9/10' collides with a second string '?a055s' plus a stray badge, rendering unreadable garbled glyphs
defects.direction: Split into separate energy count and refill-timer labels with proper spacing, and format the timer as mm:ss instead of raw 'a055s'

defects.defect: The value/timer glyphs are visibly overprinted and hard to read beside the lightning icon.
defects.direction: Render one short, clearly separated value string with consistent padding after the icon.

defects.defect: Energy chip shows garbled overlapping text ('9110' overlaid with 'a055s'), reading as a rendering bug
defects.direction: Render a single clean value in the energy chip with no overlapping label strings

defects.defect: The two melee heroes stack tightly together while a large empty arena area separates them from the enemy group.
defects.direction: Give the melee heroes distinct forward lanes and tighten the combat encounter composition.

defects.defect: Mage cards have no card frames/backgrounds — portrait ring, name, HP bar and gear tiles float on the flat brown panel with unequal left offsets and the HP bar wider than the tile pair
defects.direction: Wrap each mage in an equal-width framed card, center contents, and align HP bar width to the gear-tile row

defects.defect: Mage cards have no visible frames; portrait, name, HP bar and gear tiles float on the plain brown HUD background
defects.direction: Wrap each of the three mage cards in a decorated frame/panel matching the premium Kingdom Rush style of the top strip

defects.defect: A goblin at upper left is heavily occluded by the title frame, making the encounter look cropped.
defects.direction: Keep enemy spawn sprites fully below the banner or reduce the banner's vertical footprint.
defects.region: upper arena below the level banner

defects.defect: Stage track is a bare thin line with unstyled diamond/circle nodes, unframed and colliding with the cactus prop at (85,860); it reads as a debug overlay rather than a painted UI rail
defects.direction: Give the track a framed wood/metal rail with consistent styled node medallions, inset it from the arena edge and clear it of props

defects.defect: Damage numbers '52'/'41'/'64' overlap each other and are clipped by the top frame edge, and one sits behind a prop
defects.direction: Stagger damage-number spawn offsets, clamp them below the top frame, and raise their z-order above props

defects.defect: The two melee mages overlap shoulder-to-shoulder with near-identical z-depth and are static mid-field, not staged as advancing toward the goblin group
defects.direction: Separate them horizontally, offset their y for depth, and push them up-field toward the enemy line

defects.defect: Name labels are left-shifted against the portrait rings and use saturated per-hero colors with no outline, reducing readability on brown
defects.direction: Center names over their card, add a dark outline/shadow and consistent weight

defects.defect: Three goblins overlap each other heavily into one tangled cluster, hurting readability
defects.direction: Space advancing goblins so silhouettes and HP/damage feedback stay individually readable

defects.defect: The title strip is disproportionately tall and compresses the usable battle arena.
defects.direction: Reduce its height while retaining the framed title, speed chip, and pause control.

defects.defect: Enemy sprites vary in scale and the far-left goblin is faded/lower contrast, breaking the consistent sprite scale of the wave
defects.direction: Normalize enemy sprite scale and opacity across the wave
defects.region: goblins top-right vs lone goblin top-left (170,400)

defects.defect: Top-left goblin and a damage number ('32'/'41') are clipped by the bottom edge of the title banner frame
defects.direction: Spawn enemies and draw damage numbers below the banner, or clip them cleanly at the arena top instead of behind the frame
defects.region: top of arena under title banner (~y370-430)

defects.defect: Empty dark-brown letterbox band below the HUD cards
defects.direction: Extend the HUD panel to the safe-area bottom or fill the band with panel texture so it reads intentional

defects.defect: Skull/cactus prop overlaps the stage track line and node, muddying the track
defects.direction: Offset the prop or the track so track nodes stay unobstructed
defects.region: left stage track at cactus prop (~x60-130, y790-910)

defects.defect: The terrain dressing becomes sparse and the arena reads flatter than the polished UI and character art.
defects.direction: Add subtle terrain variation and a few grounded environmental details without crowding gameplay space.

defects.direction: Add painted ground shading, edge foliage/rock clusters on both flanks, and dress the camp ledge with planks/crates and a lit edge
defects.region: arena flanks and bottom camp strip
